numeric_profile.projection_accumulation: accepted signed Q53.48 complete projection with one FP16 rounding

rtl.position_acceptance: strictly contiguous from zero; no masking, wrapping, clamping, or aliasing

input.rope: 32 indexed FP16 cosine/sine pairs for the exact position
input.state_in: required exactly when position is greater than zero and accepted only against the runtime's independently trusted chain-tip commitment

output.state_out: Verilator opaque --savable image committed only after a natural token terminal

transaction.lineage: Every canonical exact-schema state envelope is authenticated before restore against an independently held trusted tip that binds the envelope, opaque state, retained transition input/output, compiled binary, fixed checkpoint, layer, cache slot, and next causal position. Parent lineage remains recursive beneath that externally anchored tip.

trusted_tip.runtime: one exact-schema caller-held commitment per indexed layer; it is never reconstructed from the mutable envelope being validated
trusted_tip.resume_checkpoint: canonical tip checkpoints are accepted only with a separately carried expected bytes/SHA256 record and matching build binding
trusted_tip.failure_policy: missing, stale, malformed, or mismatched commitments fail before --state-in

execution_footprint.compiled_layers: one stripped self-contained executable and one canonical authenticated manifest per indexed layer
execution_footprint.compiled_manifest_binding: layer index, contract, source SHA256 values, exact Verilator configuration SHA256, and stripped executable SHA256
execution_footprint.temporary_build: one reusable external Mdir is removed after every success or failure before the retained executable is self-tested
execution_footprint.tensor_workspace: one layer of authenticated hex vectors, removed after each indexed RTL transaction
execution_footprint.tensor_manifests: compact per-layer manifests persist for checkpoint lineage
execution_footprint.trace_storage: each raw trace is SHA256-authenticated, deterministically gzip-compressed, restoration-verified, and then replaced by its archive

included: full-vocabulary greedy selection with lowest-token-ID tie break
independent PyTorch CPU float64 dequantized-AWQ comparison

token0_disclosure.definition: Token-0 is the first generated token selected from the layer-23 output of the final prompt token.
token0_disclosure.feedback_rule: Token-0 is represented by every indexed RTL layer at the next position only when generation continues after its selection.
token0_disclosure.terminal_selection_rule: The final selected token is reported but is not claimed as an RTL input unless another decision is requested.

claim_boundary.hybrid_rtl_requires: A successful document must contain one natural indexed Verilator transaction for every represented token and every layer.
claim_boundary.software_only_prohibition: Software/oracle Model24 execution must never be labeled RTL.
